basis.composed: composed here from registered pieces (the registered weighting on pooled units, or the 1/M mean); analyse.py does not report it
basis.registered_and_verified: registered and verified: equal to the registered results.json, to the bit
basis.rule: every by_model number is registered and verified; the all-models pooled fixes, corruptions, catches and false_flags are registered and verified; everything else pooled, and every equal-weight number, is composed: cite it as composed, never as registered

definitions.by_model: the registered per-arm numbers of the model's arm, to the bit (asserted before this file is written)
definitions.equal_weight_per_model: the 1/M mean over the M declared models of the per-model estimates; its interval is the percentile interval (stats.interval, 95%, inverted-CDF quantiles) over the defined resamples of the 1/M mean of the per-model draws (stats.ratio_draws) on the one resample matrix; no studentisation; a model with an empty denominator makes the mean not estimable (never dropped) and a resample undefined; exploratory

excluded_metrics.number_traceability_flag_rate: not a baseline quantity (the ontology checks' substantive layer or number traceability)
excluded_metrics.substantive_coverage: not a baseline quantity (the ontology checks' substantive layer or number traceability)
excluded_metrics.substantive_pass_share: not a baseline quantity (the ontology checks' substantive layer or number traceability)

labels.accuracy: accuracy of the initial output over N_att: the natural parent's
labels.accuracy_final: accuracy over all attempts (N_att) after the retry; a failed, abstained or missing retry counts wrong
labels.corruption_rate: per flagged output: P(wrong after the retry | right, flagged, retried)
labels.corruptions: corrupted (right -> wrong after the retry) per attempt, over N_att
labels.fix_rate: per flagged output: P(right after the retry | wrong, flagged, retried)
labels.fixes: fixed (wrong -> right after the retry) per attempt, over N_att
labels.flag_rate: retried share of outputs: F / N_out (a flag always retries); counts retried, N_out and N_att beside it
labels.net_change: net change against the natural parent: (fixed - corrupted) / N_att

definitions.pooled_over_attempts: the models' units pooled, then the registered weighting (prereg section 3): for fixes, corruptions, catches and false_flags of the all-models variant it is pipeline.real_output_ledger's row; every other pooled quantity, and every pooled quantity of the without_waived_models variant, is composed here the same way
definitions.reported_with: the baseline rows are reported beside C5's rows only (appendix material, prereg line 308); nothing in this file is compared with C5's rows

resampling.scheme: the per-arm stratified matrix of pipeline.analyse (stats.resample_matrix), as analyse.py uses it for every arm and real_output_ledger row
